name: monotone_filtration_convergence_classical
divergence_log: Classical filtrations are nested sigma-algebras of commuting events. Quantum filtrations are nested von Neumann subalgebras with noncommuting projections; conditional expectation is replaced by operator-valued projection. This baseline drops the noncommutativity.
